title: eligamo's Flowable usage sits inside its own bank front-office product, not in client delivery
content:
eligamo AG embeds Flowable in its own bank front-office product. As with the other OEM entries in the sweep, the research records the consequence rather than the relationship: vendor, not an integrator.

The pattern across the sweep is the more useful finding. At least three of the entries mined from the Flowable Partner Finder on 2026-08-18 are OEMs — Avaloq in core banking, Exentra in project controlling, eligamo in bank front-office — and two of the three build for banks. A vendor's partner directory rewards anyone shipping its engine, whether they resell delivery capacity or quietly compile it into a product, so the list conflates two populations that need opposite treatment.

For eligamo specifically, that leaves nothing actionable in the current record. The row was not imprint-swept, no principal or contact was resolved, and the only substantive claim is the OEM classification itself.
